title: Length of Last Word
description: Given a string `s` of words separated by spaces, return the length of its last word. A word is a maximal non-empty sequence of non-space characters.
constraints: s contains English letters and spaces
s contains at least one word
hints: Scan the string while tracking the needed counts or positions.
Check repeated characters and boundary cases.

examples.input: s = " fly me to the moon "
